description: A 2HP display showing a single line of text running down the rack, for labelling or separating parts of a patch.
notes: the display starts empty; click it and type. It takes the keyboard like any text field, and what you type runs down the rack on one line at a fixed size.
a TF-101 or TF-102 placed immediately to the left or right sets the formatting instead, with no cable.
menu: Foreground — a submenu setting the colour of the text: a field taking a hex colour, then Blue, Yellow, Red, Green, Orange, Pink and White.
Background — a submenu setting the colour behind the text: a field taking a hex colour, then None, Black and White.
Visuals — a submenu of Blue, Dark and Light for the colour scheme, plus Flat for a look without the 3D shading. The choice covers every SubmarineFree module and is kept outside the patch.
